sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Cell-surface ELISA confirmed surface display of the HA-tagged receptor; no functional (signalling) assay reported in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: P2RY6 is a GPCR with no signal peptide; topology landmarks place residues 1–26 extracellular and residues 305–328 intracellular, making the N-terminus the only extracellular terminus available for a prepend tag. The paper (L1/L2) reports N-terminally HA-tagged P2Y6 orthologs with confirmed cell-surface expression but names no specific residue, so the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue = 0, residue_after = M (residue 1, verified from the numbered sequence). The 26-residue extracellular N-terminal span provides ample clearance (≥3 residues) from TM1 starting at residue 27. HEK293T cells transiently transfected with N-terminally HA-tagged vertebrate P2Y6 orthologs (including human P2Y6); cell-surface expression confirmed by cell-surface ELISA (PMC9305961). No signal peptide in P2RY6; the N-terminus (residues 1–26) is the sole extracellular terminus, so the N-terminal tag prepends before M1.

sources.claim: ( C ) HEK293T cells were transiently transfected with either HA‐tagged version of the indicated vertebrate P2Y 6 orthologs and the expression levels of receptors were measured by a cell surface ELISA (see Experimental Section ).

literature_notes: L1 and L2 are from the same paper (PMC9305961) and describe the same experiment (N-terminal HA tag, cell-surface ELISA); they support a single site. Neither clip names a specific residue number, so position_evidence is topology_derived. The C-terminus (residues 305–328) is intracellular and therefore not a surface-tag site. The four extracellular loops (ECL1: 85–96, ECL2: 166–188, ECL3: 266–277) are not supported by any ledger clip and are not proposed. A potential N-glycosylation sequon at N5 (N-G-T) lies within the extracellular N-terminal region but downstream of the prepend junction and is not disrupted by the tag.
